'''2014 Worlds Day 3 Emil Wallin LS Mind What You Have Learned''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Emil Wallin]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 3).

Typed onto the forum by AnakinSolo from Emil's Day 3 sheet (Holotable type groups). A numbered scan of the same Light list is page 7 of [[File:2014 Worlds Day 3.pdf]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Mind What You Have Learned (V) / Save You It Can (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
